name: Poshan Calculator
desc_short: WHO-based Child Growth & Nutrition Assessment App
desc: A Flutter application that helps parents and healthcare professionals assess child growth using WHO standards through fast, accurate and easy-to-use nutrition calculations.
overview: Poshan Calculator was built to simplify child growth monitoring by providing quick nutritional assessments based on WHO growth standards. The application enables users to calculate and track growth parameters using a clean, intuitive mobile experience.
challenge: Growth assessment often requires multiple manual calculations and reference charts, making it difficult for parents and healthcare workers to perform quick evaluations accurately.
solution: Designed and developed a Flutter application that automates growth calculations, provides instant nutritional assessments and delivers an intuitive experience for monitoring children's development.
responsibilities: Published and maintained the application on Google Play

highlights.title: WHO Standards
highlights.description: Implements child growth assessment based on internationally recognized WHO growth standards.

highlights.title: Healthcare Focus
highlights.description: Built for parents, guardians and healthcare professionals to monitor child nutrition and development.

highlights.title: Performance
highlights.description: Lightweight Flutter application delivering quick calculations with a clean and responsive interface.

data_safety.shared_data: No data shared with third parties
